ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( TEXT(Status) = "Qualified", TEXT(Status) = "Closed - Converted" ), OR( NOT(REGEX(CNPJ__c, "\\d{14}")), AND(ISBLANK(Email), ISBLANK(Phone), ISBLANK(WhatsApp__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(Porte__c)), ISBLANK(Segmento_CNAE__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Para qualificar o lead, preencha CNPJ, e-mail, telefone ou WhatsApp, porte e segmento.
